criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.evidence: A11yTree exposes role/name hierarchy and focus_order (accessibility.rs T119)

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: design-system contrast_pairs >= 4.5:1 verified by the audit contract; high-contrast theme

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: responsive layout (layoutFor) reflows to 320px without loss; terminal reflows on resize (T072)

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.evidence: focus ring (blue.500/300) and borders meet 3:1 against surfaces

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.evidence: no fixed-height clipping in terminal rows; full reflow audit on native hosts pending
criteria.remediation: verify 1.5 line-height / 2 letter-spacing overrides on native terminals

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: full keyboard protocol (input-adapter + terminal keyboard protocol T108); command palette reachable by keyboard

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.evidence: no auto-moving content; animations respect ReduceMotionPolicy (T119)

criteria.name: Three Flashes
criteria.evidence: no flashing content; renderer produces static frames

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.evidence: explicit focus color token; A11yTree focus_order; keyboard focus indicators

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.evidence: gesture features require an explicit alternative control (T109/T119)

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: spacing tokens provide adequate padding; 24x24 CSS px targets modeled
criteria.remediation: verify >= 24x24 CSS px on native widgets in the device matrix

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.evidence: A11yNode accessible_name + role; semantic model for screen readers
